## Other AXI tools

- [`atl-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/atl-axi): Atlassian Jira Cloud CLI for agents
- [`bb-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bb-axi): Bitbucket Cloud CLI for agents
- [`hetzner-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/hetzner-axi): Hetzner Cloud CLI for agents
- [`mongo-rw-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mongo-rw-axi): Write-capable MongoDB CLI for agents, loopback hosts only
- [`mysql-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mysql-axi): Read-only MySQL CLI for agents
- [`mysql-rw-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mysql-rw-axi): Write-capable MySQL CLI for agents, loopback hosts only
- [`ts-axi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/ts-axi): TypeScript symbol CLI for agents
